name: pilot
description: Varsiko Agent 4. Executes one signed, human-approved migration mandate: provisions a server, installs Coolify, loads environment variables, deploys, then halts for audit. Decides nothing; holds no provider credentials.

skills.name: Start a migration run
skills.description: Accepts a signed mandate, verifies it, claims the nonce write-ahead, and returns a run_id immediately. Does not block: the flow guard kills any call at 120s, and a full migration takes 3-6 minutes.

skills.name: Poll a migration run
skills.description: Returns current step, state, committed cost, and the next owner. Callers poll this until state is DEPLOYED, FAILED or ROLLED_BACK.

skills.name: Cut over DNS
skills.description: Points the domain at the new server. Requires an Auditor pass token AND passes through an ask-stance tool, so a human approves in Nasiko before it executes.
examples: Auditor passed with token apt_44. Cut over.
